detail.longDescription: Some pages give a plain fetch almost nothing because the content is built in the browser. Cheap pattern for agents: call Extract first (URL to clean markdown, $0.002; include_links:false skips nav tokens). Only if it comes back empty, retry with Render, which loads the page in a real browser ($0.005). Free trial: 5 extracts + 3 renders a day per IP, no key. Then USDC per call over x402 on Base; failed or empty calls aren't charged. https:// agentsearchhq.com/render?utm_s ource=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=render # AIagents # MCP # x402
